details: This package is a dependency-confusion placeholder: a scoped name published at sentinel version 99.1.1 with a near-empty tarball (three files, ~1.5 KB unpacked). Its package.json declares a preinstall hook that runs `node index.js`, and index.js immediately performs an outbound HTTPS GET to hxxps://realwbx[.]com/ip.php?ip=8[.]8[.]8[.]8 carrying a hardcoded Authorization header value. The request fires on every install, before any user code runs, and the package's stated purpose (an IP-location lookup) does not require an install-time callback. No environment variables, credential files, or host data are read or transmitted by the script.
